question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 guidance was $197-202B (9-12% YoY, includes ~80bp FX headwind); consensus ~$202.1B. Amazon has usually printed at or above the top of guidance (from memory: Q3'25 +0.7B, Q4'25 +0.4B, Q1'26 ~+3B, Q2'25 +3.7B; confirmed this run: Q2'26 +1.6B over the $199B top), the exception being Q4'24 at -0.7B. AWS capacity sold out and accelerating (~37-41% growth expected), so I center ~$203.8B, about 0.8% above consensus. Downside: a weak Prime Day/retail period or a worse FX headwind; upside: AWS/ads beats. No Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold market found.

calls.reasoning: Guidance $197-202B (80bp FX headwind assumed); consensus ~$202.1B. Over 8 quarters actual vs guidance top ranged -0.7B to +3.7B (median ~+0.55B, mean ~+1.2B); the latest two quarters beat by +3.0B and +1.6B with AWS accelerating (~37%). FX roughly neutral vs assumptions; Prime Day shift to Q2 already in guidance. Median ~$203.2B. No Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold market found by any run; none checked this run (no web access).
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the guidance ($197-202B), consensus (~$202.1-202.2B) and the beat history; the older quarters' guidance figures partly came from memory, and one Q4'24 figure conflicts between runs (Run 1 says top 188.5; Run 3 has range 181.5-188.5, actual 187.8), but both imply a ~-0.7B miss and neither changes the conclusion. FX was roughly neutral (EUR/USD flat; dollar softer Jul-Aug, firmer in Sept). The only real dispute is a judgment call: how much weight to give the bigger recent beats (Run 1 median 203.8B vs Runs 2-3 ~203.0-203.2B). I weighted them moderately against the 8-quarter median beat, giving a median of 203.2B. I carried Run 1/3's dispersion (~4.3B) forward. I declared no escape mass: going outside 198-209B would need an unprecedented ~4B miss or ~7B beat.
